title: Non-additive symmetric rank-metric codes
summary: We study non-additive rank-metric codes contained in the space of symmetric matrices over a finite field. Our main focus is on symmetric $2$-codes. For odd $q$, we introduce a quotient construction for $\mathrm{Sym}_3(q)$ in which rank-one differences are described by isotropic vectors of a nondegenerate quadratic form on $\mathbb F_q^4$. This leads to a correspondence with partial ovoids of the elliptic quadric $Q^-(5,q)$.
